testCases.title: Successful Filtering by Category
steps: Select a specified category from the filter options.
expectedResults: Items are displayed that belong to the selected category.

testCases.title: Error Message for Non-existing Category Filtering
steps: Select a non-existing category from the filter options.
expectedResults: An appropriate error message is displayed.

testCases.title: Correct Set of Items Displayed after Filtering
steps: Select a specified category from the filter options.
expectedResults: The displayed items match the criteria of the selected category.
